flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3002/app then Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00".
Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".

remark: scroll: Scrolling to the Billing section to find the quota top-up control
scroll: Scrolling down to locate the Billing quota top-up control
wait: Waiting without interacting with the covered quota top-up control

summary:
The test assumed the quota top-up button would be reachable, but the page was still in its cookie-consent state. The stated rules prohibited dismissing or working around the banner.
Prepare the test session with cookie consent already resolved, or change the test setup so the required control is reachable without any prohibited interaction.
one_liner: The run began with an open cookie-consent banner that covered the quota top-up control, so the required mouse click could not be made.
